exceptions.meaning: The protected local boundary has no valid authenticated principal context.
The authenticated principal is not authorized for the exact requested Cabinet operation.
The exact accepted invoice or revision target required by the operation cannot be resolved.
Submitted source evidence is unsupported, unreadable, wrong-target, hash-mismatched, or otherwise rejected by accepted archive policy.
Current Registry observation required by the requested operation is unavailable or cannot be accepted safely.
No accepted assignment-validation evidence exists for the exact requested Card revision context.
The supplied PresuPro observation cannot be accepted as a valid immutable EstimateSnapshot input.
Pinned project/invoice/estimate/match evidence is missing, incompatible, unresolved, or otherwise insufficient for reproducible plan-versus-actual calculation.
The exact Invoice Card revision does not satisfy accepted Cabinet publication eligibility or duplicate-prevention conditions.
The logical Holded publication remains ambiguous, conflicting, or business-verification-incomplete and requires reconciliation.
The requested VPS release lacks required durable-local proof or otherwise fails the accepted manual-release preconditions.
